items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Scott LaFarro would come and pick them up and use them as exercises on the bass; he would play those things.

ctx.x: They really required virtuosity but I didn’t need it to write them cause I would think about each note very slowly. Come up with things that I thought were perfect and then Paul Bley would play them, or even Ned he would play them. Scott... what was the bass player’s name, Scott...
